## What should the automation do?

Describe the desired result in one or two sentences.

## Bexio operation / object

What should happen in Bexio?

Examples of the type of answer:

- read an object
- create / update an object
- trigger another workflow from a Bexio API result

You do not need to know the exact endpoint URL.

## Existing n8n workflow

- [ ] An n8n workflow already exists
- [ ] This is a new workflow
- [ ] Not sure

## Bexio API / OAuth readiness

- [ ] Bexio API / OAuth access is already prepared
- [ ] Bexio API / OAuth access still needs setup
- [ ] Not sure

## Trigger / source

What starts the workflow and where does the source data come from?

## Data mapping

Which source fields need to be mapped to / from Bexio?

Please use synthetic example field names / values where possible.

## Expected result

What should count as successful completion?

## Scope notes

Mention any known:

- additional systems
- multiple Bexio objects
- bulk processing
- document handling
- reconciliation
- retry / idempotency requirements

## Public / private data warning

**Do NOT paste:**

- passwords
- OAuth client secrets
- access / refresh tokens
- customer personal data
- production credentials
- confidential documents

If sensitive details are required later, they must be handled through an appropriate private channel after scope is agreed.

https://github.com/weissalexey/aw-n8n-workflow-help/blob/main/guides/n8n-bexio-api-integration-readiness.md

## Non-binding request

Opening this issue is only a request to discuss and scope the work.
Final scope, access method, delivery terms, and payment method must be agreed before paid work begins.
